name: Tarkov Craft
teaser: A web-based tool for creating custom hideout craft recipes.
description:
Mods on Hiatus / Support Paused

  • Status: No updates planned due to focus on other projects.
  • Open Invitation: The community has full permission to update, modify, and redistribute these mods. Feel free to fork the repository and build your own version.
Basics

Try the tool HERE

Tarkov Craft is a web-based tool to create and customize crafting recipes and barter trades. With an intuitive interface, you can experiment with ingredients, tools, and crafting times while generating JSONs for easy integration into your projects.

JSON Structure

Each craft is exported as a JSON object following SPT’s hideout recipe format:

{
  "_id": "507f1f77bcf86cd799439011",
  "areaType": 10,
  "requirements": [
    {
      "areaType": 10,
      "requiredLevel": 2,
      "type": "Area"
    },
    {
      "templateId": "5c0e874186f7745dc7616606",
      "count": 2,
      "isFunctional": false,
      "isEncoded": false,
      "type": "Item"
    }
  ],
  "productionTime": 7200,
  "needFuelForAllProductionTime": false,
  "locked": false,
  "endProduct": "5c0e874186f7745dc7616606",
  "continuous": false,
  "count": 1,
  "productionLimitCount": 0,
  "isEncoded": false,
  "isCodeProduction": false
}
Usage

Option 1 — Use with TarkovCraft Loader (no coding required)

If you don’t want to write a mod from scratch, use TarkovCraft Loader — drop your exported JSON file into the mod’s folder and it will inject your custom crafts into the SPT server automatically.

Option 2 — Use the JSON in your own mod

If you’re building your own mod, copy the exported JSON and push the recipes into SPT

Known Issues
  • If you find any bugs, please report them

versions.description:
Tarkov Craft v2.0.0 — Full Rewrite

Complete rewrite from the ground up. Same purpose, entirely new codebase.

What changed

  • New UI built from scratch with an EFT-inspired design
  • Item search rebuilt as a virtual-scroll combobox with keyboard navigation

What was dropped

  • Quest creation
  • Barter creation

These may return in future releases as separate modules.

Try the tool HERE

- Updated to 3.11.x

- The quest creation feature has been removed due to technical issues and to better align the mod with its core purpose.

- I’ve tested the mod with 5 new crafts and barters on a clean SPT installation, and it loaded normally for me. If you encounter any issues, please let me know!
